title: Key West Private Snorkeling & Reef Boat Charter
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This private Key West snorkeling charter avoids the fixed schedule and crowds of a large group boat. The captain selects suitable sites according to visibility, tides, weather, safety, and guest experience. Your group can prioritize snorkeling, swimming, marine-life viewing, or a sandbar stop when conditions and charter length permit.
